evidence_excerpts: A significant drug versus time interaction was observed (F(56) = 3.13, p = 0.041, one-tailed).

Post-hoc tests reveal that shifts away from hard materialism were evident in the psilocybin group only (Z = 2.28, p = 0.02, d = 0.45). The escitalopram group showed no changes in NPB (Z = 0.24, p = 0.33, d = 0.2).
text: In a randomized controlled depression trial, psilocybin therapy produced shifts away from hard materialism at six weeks whereas escitalopram did not.
